title: Warm Canadian Macaroni Pasta
description: A citrusy and shattering ovo-vegetarian Canadian dish featuring macaroni, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, that is sure to please crowds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large ttukbaegi earthenware pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the lemon juice and vegetable broth, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked macaroni to the pot, stirring to combine with the sauce.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and top with grated cheddar cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
